name: x-poster
description: Post a tweet or thread (with optional image) to X, or schedule posts — one or up to 20 in bulk — via vibedraft. Preview cost first; never auto-publishes.

tools.name: preview_post
tools.description: Validate + cost-preview a tweet/thread. No side effects.

tools.name: publish_post
tools.description: Post to X after explicit confirmation. The only writer.

tools.name: preview_article
tools.description: Convert markdown to an X Article and preview it. No side effects.

tools.name: publish_article
tools.description: Create an X Article: a private draft by default, public only with publish:true.

tools.name: preview_bulk
tools.description: Validate + cost-preview up to 20 posts to bulk-schedule via vibedraft. No side effects.

tools.name: schedule_bulk
tools.description: Schedule up to 20 posts (each at its own time) via vibedraft after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a post/thread for a future time via vibedraft after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: cancel_scheduled
tools.description: Cancel a pending vibedraft scheduled post before it fires.

tools.name: authorize
tools.description: Connect your X account — returns a link to click. One-time, no terminal.

tools.name: auth_instructions
tools.description: Setup help (X app checklist + auth options).

X_CLIENT_ID.title: X API Client ID
X_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth2 client ID from your X Developer App. After installing, ask Claude to "authorize x-poster" and click the link to connect your account.

X_CLIENT_SECRET.title: X API Client Secret
X_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth2 client secret from your X Developer App

X_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: X Refresh Token (optional)
X_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Leave blank — after installing, just ask Claude to run the authorize tool and click the link. (Power users: paste a token minted via bin/x-auth.mjs instead.)

X_AUTH_PORT.title: Authorize callback port (optional)
X_AUTH_PORT.description: Leave blank to use 8723. Only change this if port 8723 is already in use on your machine — and if you do, register http://127.0.0.1:<this-port>/callback as the callback URL in your X app, or the authorize step will fail.

X_MAX_TWEET_CHARS.title: Max characters per post (optional)
X_MAX_TWEET_CHARS.description: Leave blank — character count won't block posting (long-form X Premium content works, and X enforces your account's real limit when you post). Set this to 280 only if you want the classic limit enforced locally before posting.

VIBEDRAFT_API_URL.title: vibedraft API URL (optional, for scheduling)
VIBEDRAFT_API_URL.description: Leave blank unless you schedule posts via vibedraft. Usually https://vibedraft.app — scheduling tools (schedule_post, schedule_bulk, list_scheduled, cancel_scheduled) need this plus the token below.

VIBEDRAFT_API_TOKEN.title: vibedraft API token (optional, for scheduling)
VIBEDRAFT_API_TOKEN.description: Leave blank unless you schedule posts via vibedraft. Create a Personal Access Token (vd_pat_...) in vibedraft under Settings → API tokens with posts:read + posts:write scopes.
